rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates
rules.conflict_note: This document is a draft ordinance (O-2025-107) with blank passage, mayor and clerk signature lines, dated Nov 2024 and staff report Feb 27, 2025; it does not show adoption, so status is pending and effective date unknown. Enactment status UNVERIFIED from this document; check a later source.
rules.interaction: No state-level conflict is discussed in the document.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords and sellers of rent-setting software for residential rental property in the City of San Diego; takes effect on the 30th day after final passage
rules.exemptions: software that publishes reports from public information or from aggregated nonpublic data more than 90 days old without recommending future rents; software used to set rents or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.title: San Diego Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing (proposed Div. 11)
rules.requirement: Proposed ordinance bans selling, licensing or providing, and a landlord's use of, software that uses nonpublic competitor data to advise or recommend rents or occupancy levels; tenants may sue for injunction, damages or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees.

notes: Draft ordinance package (staff report, ordinance, digest, strikeout version); final passage date is blank. Adds Division 11 to ch. 9 art. 8. No effective date can be computed without the passage date.
